cmd: uv run --locked python quality/check_numbers.py --selftest && { uv run --locked python quality/check_numbers.py 2>&1 || true; } | tail -n 1 | grep -Eq '^check_numbers: [0-9]+ file\(s\), [1-9][0-9]* traceable value\(s\), [0-9]+ untraced literal\(s\), 0 bad source line\(s\), [0-9]+ word-number warning\(s\)$' && uv run --locked python -c 'import os, sys; sys.path.insert(0, "quality"); import check_numbers as C; F = lambda c, m: c or sys.exit("W7.3 FAIL: " + m); src = (C.LEDGER, C.PRIOR_ART, C.ALLOW); F(src == ("docs/numbers.json", "docs/priorart-numbers.txt", "docs/numbers-allow.txt"), "the sources differ from SOP section 2.8: %s" % (src,)); F(tuple(C.DEFAULT_SCOPE) == ("abstract", "docs/memo") and C.LABEL == "WR-07", "the scope or the label differs from WR-07"); S = "sop/SOP-final.md"; s = open(S, encoding="utf-8").read() if os.path.isfile(S) else ""; T = ["**One gate at `quality/check_numbers.py`**, reading `docs/numbers.json`", "plus `docs/priorart-numbers.txt` and `docs/numbers-allow.txt`", "WR-07 every numeric literal in `abstract/` and `docs/memo/` present in `docs/numbers.json`, `docs/priorart-numbers.txt` or `docs/numbers-allow.txt`"]; F(not s or all(t in s for t in T), "sop/SOP-final.md no longer states the gate as registered: %s" % [t for t in T if t not in s]); v, n, p = C.ledger_values(); F(not p and not n, "a source is missing or malformed: %s %s" % (n, p)); print("W7.3 OK: quality/check_numbers.py reads the 3 SOP sources, %d traceable values, 0 bad source lines; WR-07 scope abstract/ and docs/memo/; SOP text %s" % (len(v), "matched" if s else "absent, constants checked only"))'
title: Writing standard: the number gate
